headline: As of 2026-10-21: 15,471,398 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 44 of 50 states, D+16.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 15,471,398 early/mail ballots cast so far across 44 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+16.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,854,319), Florida (1,425,810), Texas (1,365,774).
